changed: Mark all performed now also sets the program's status to Performed, so a finished gig no longer stays a Draft on the Programs list. This is on by default: turn off Mark all performed sets the status in Settings › Program › Calling history to keep the status separate. Undo puts the marks and the status back together.
The status field in the program editor now says what saving a change to Performed does: it marks every unmarked dance except alternates, and changing the status back keeps the marks.

added: `ProgramRepository.clearPerformedAtIfMatches` takes an optional `restoreStatus`: in the same transaction, the program's status goes back to it while it is still Performed.
